exposure: positive rate of CD62p and CD63
cohort: 23 patients with postpartum deep vein thrombosis of the lower extremity and 25 controls with normal recovery.
finding: Platelet aggregation activity is elevated in postpartum deep vein thrombosis patients and has predictive value for the occurrence of postpartum deep vein thrombosis of the lower extremity.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the control group than in the postpartum deep vein thrombosis group (p<0.05).
